title: Alert Briefing Pane and Retrospective Links — Prototype
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design a compact 'Alert Briefing' pane that surfaces critical SLO context, a short incident timeline, and one-click retrospective links (postmortem, RCA, playbook) anchored to each alert in the Console. The feature should reduce time-to-triage for on-call engineers and make it easy to attach post-incident artifacts directly from the alert surface.
acceptance_criteria: Briefing pane shows SLO state with color-coded indicator and primary metric (error rate/latency) for the affected service
Timeline preview displays first 3 events and link to full incident trace in incidents view
Quick actions: Acknowledge, Assign, Open Playbook, Attach Postmortem Link
Retrospective link flow opens a modal to paste or create a postmortem link; link appears in alert timeline and incident metadata
Mobile and narrow viewport flows show a collapsed briefing with 'Open Briefing' CTA
Design passes accessibility contrast and keyboard navigation checks
design_notes: Prioritize skimmability — avoid full incident content within alerts; provide clear doorway to the incidents page
SLO context should default to the primary SLO for the service, with a chevron to view alternatives
Consider permission gating for 'Attach Postmortem' based on RBAC from Private product
Keep quick actions idempotent (double-confirm destructive ops) and track telemetry events for A/B experiments
decisions: Use compact timeline cards (3 rows) rather than expandable full timeline in the alert list to avoid list density regressions
Display SLO delta (current vs baseline) inline to speed triage decisions
Retrospective links stored as plain URLs in incident metadata to avoid heavy editor integration in v1

review_feedback: PM (Ravi): Make 'Attach Postmortem' require confirmation for non-admins — Risk: accidental link spam
Eng (Lena): Need a small schema change to store multiple retrospective links; prefer an array in incident metadata (ENG-4821)
Security: Check RBAC for private deployments — may need feature flag in Private builds
Design (Maya): Consider collapsing SLO sparkline to a micro-chart to save vertical space
implementation_notes: Backend: incident metadata endpoint to accept 'retrospective_links' array (ENG-4821)
Frontend: briefings render in alert list row; open modal to attach link which triggers PATCH to incidents API
Rollout: feature-flagged for 10% of hosted accounts then 100% after metrics meet success criteria
